finding: I5 ONE-SALE-ONE-ADDRESS breached: 7 sales were each held in up to 4 cardId partitions at once, and in none of them is either copy both coherent and catalog-backed - so every copy parks identityUnverified rather than one being promoted on no evidence.
rulings: CF-ONE-CARD-ONE-ROW-ONE-POOL: one sale resident under more than one cardId partition is a split pool AND a double count. The sale is priced twice and each copy's pool trend is computed from a fraction of its own comps, so FMV is wrong on both addresses (#1956).

CF-ABSENT-BEATS-WRONG: where neither copy is both coherent and catalog-backed there is no evidence to promote one, so EVERY copy is PARKED identityUnverified rather than one being guessed. PARK is a marker, never a delete - it patches in place and is reversible (#1956).
